## Why This Is Asked

Assesses ability to design a robust, Azure-native API gateway handling per-tenant isolation, dynamic canary deployments, and precise quota controls under load.

## Key Concepts

- Tenant isolation in API Management with per-tenant rate limits
- Redis-based token-bucket or sliding-window throttling
- Canary deployments via APIM revisions and feature flags
- Global routing with Azure Front Door
- Observability and audit trails in Cosmos DB and Application Insights

## Code Example

```xml
<policies>
  <inbound>
    <rate-limit-by-key calls="1000" renewal-period="60" counter-key="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault('tenantId','anonymous'))" />
  </inbound>
</policies>
```

```lua
-- Redis Lua example (tenant-scoped bucket)
local key = KEYS[1]
local now = tonumber(ARGV[1])
local capacity = tonumber(ARGV[2])
local refill = tonumber(ARGV[3])
local tokens = tonumber(redis.call('GET', key) or capacity)
if tokens <= 0 then
  return {err="rate-limited"}
else
  redis.call('SET', key, tokens-1, 'EX', 60)
  return {ok, tokens-1}
end
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you test race conditions in quota counters under high concurrency?
- How would you monitor and alert on tenant quota breaches without noisy alerts?
